Why Study in Germany?

Country-specific advantages for academic and career progression

Tuition-Free Public Universities

Public universities in Germany charge zero tuition fees, only a small semester contribution covering public transit.

Global Engineering & Tech Hub

Home to global industrial giants (Siemens, BMW, Bosch, Mercedes, SAP) offering unmatched engineering internships.

18-Month Job Seeker Visa

Graduates receive an 18-month residence permit to find employment in their field across Germany and the EU.

Schengen Visa Mobility

Travel freely across 29 European Schengen countries during your studies in Germany.

Education Pathway for Bangladeshi Students

Step-by-step qualification progression for SSC, HSC, Diploma, and Bachelor graduates

Pathway 1

SSC / O-Level

High School Bridge / Preparatory German Course

Intensive German language preparation leading into Studienkolleg.

Pathway 2

HSC / A-Level

1-Year Studienkolleg (Foundation) → 3-Year Bachelor Degree

Bridge the 12-year education gap through public Studienkolleg or direct entry with 1-year university in Bangladesh.

Pathway 3

Diploma (4-Year BTEB)

Bachelor of Engineering / Applied Sciences

Polytechnic diploma holders enter German Universities of Applied Sciences with credit recognition.

Pathway 4

Bachelor Degree (4 Years)

2-Year English-Taught Master's Degree (MSc / MEng)

Direct admission for Bachelor graduates with CGPA 3.0+ from recognized Bangladeshi universities.

* Final eligibility depends on university, course, academic profile, English score, study gap and other admission requirements.

Germany Student Visa Process

Official step-by-step roadmap from university offer to visa stamp

1

University Admission (Zulassungsbescheid)

Apply via Uni-Assist or directly to receive university admission letter.

2

Open Blocked Bank Account (€11,904)

Open account via Expatrio, Fintiba, or Coracle and deposit €11,904.

3

Purchase German Health Insurance

Get public/private health insurance (Techniker Krankenkasse or Barmer).

4

Book German Embassy Dhaka Appointment

Book appointment on the German Embassy Dhaka portal.

5

Attend Visa Interview at Embassy

Submit documents and receive National Student Visa (Type D).

Work Rights & Post-Study Route Summary

Official government rules for international students in Germany

Term-Time Work Rights:

140 full days or 280 half days per year

Vacation Work Rights:

Full-time student jobs allowed within the 140-day quota

Post-Study Work Route:

18-month Post-Study Job Seeker Residence Permit (Section 20 AufenthG).

* Visa and work rules can change. Always verify final conditions with official government sources and ALO staff before making decisions.

Frequently Asked Questions

Country-specific answers verified by ALO Education compliance

Is university education really free in Germany?

Yes, public universities in 15 out of 16 German states charge no tuition fees for international students; you only pay a semester fee of €150-€350.

What is a German Blocked Account (Sperrkonto)?

A Blocked Account is a mandatory bank account deposited with €11,904 to prove living expenses, releasing €992 each month during your stay.

Can I study in Germany in English without knowing German?

Yes, hundreds of Master's degree programs are taught 100% in English, though learning basic German (A1/A2) is helpful for daily life and part-time jobs.

What is Uni-Assist in German university admissions?

Uni-Assist is a centralized service that evaluates international school certificates and transcripts on behalf of German universities.

What is Studienkolleg?

A 1-year preparatory foundation course in Germany required for students whose 12-year high school diploma is not equivalent to the German Abitur.

How long is the Post-Study Work Visa in Germany?

Graduates receive an 18-month Job Seeker Visa to find employment related to their degree in Germany.

What is the German EU Blue Card?

An EU Blue Card is a work and residence permit for university graduates with a qualifying job contract meeting the minimum salary threshold.

How much is the minimum wage for student jobs in Germany?

The German national minimum wage is €12.41 per hour, with student jobs (Werkstudent) often paying €14 to €18 per hour.

What are the main intake semesters in Germany?

Winter Semester (starts in October) is the primary intake; Summer Semester (starts in April) is the secondary intake.

What documents are needed for the German Embassy Dhaka interview?

Admission letter, Blocked Account confirmation (€11,904), health insurance proof, academic mark sheets, motivation letter, CV, and valid passport.

Can polytechnic diploma holders from Bangladesh apply to Germany?

Yes, 4-year BTEB diploma graduates can apply for Bachelor's or Master's programs depending on university credit evaluations.

What English tests are accepted by German universities?

IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5) and TOEFL iBT (minimum 85 to 90).

What is the APS Certificate in Germany?

An APS certificate verifies the authenticity of academic documents for students from select countries.

What is a Semesterticket in Germany?

A transit pass included in your semester contribution that allows unlimited free public transportation across your state/region.

Can I travel to other European countries while studying in Germany?

Yes, your German student visa grants visa-free travel throughout the 29 Schengen member countries.

What is a Werkstudent job in Germany?

A working student position where you work up to 20 hours/week in your field of study with favorable tax and social security exemptions.

What is the minimum CGPA required for public universities in Germany?

Most competitive public universities require a minimum CGPA of 3.0 out of 4.0 (German grade 2.5 or better).

Where is the German Embassy in Bangladesh located?

Madani Avenue, Baridhara Diplomatic Enclave, Dhaka 1212.

Can I bring my spouse to Germany while studying?

Yes, Master's and PhD students with adequate living funds and suitable apartment space can apply for family reunification.

How does ALO Education assist with German university applications?

ALO Education assists with program shortlisting, Uni-Assist profile submission, Blocked Account setup, and embassy interview coaching.
